raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# What does this PR do ?

Add a deterministic variant of the Nemotron 3 Ultra 256-GPU GB200 MXFP8 perf recipe. It keeps the NCCL EP dispatcher, so the only delta vs the base recipe is determinism overhead.

# Changelog

- Add `nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_fp8mx_deterministic_config` in `perf_recipes/nemotronh/gb200/nemotronh.py`: wraps `nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config` and applies `apply_determinism_overrides` (deterministic mode, unfused CE and router aux loss, determinism env vars including `NCCL_EP_HT_EM_AG_SCAN_MODE=1`, and the Mamba/causal-conv1d flags).
- Unlike `deepseek_v3_pretrain_256gpu_gb300_fp8mx_deterministic_config`, this recipe does **not** switch to HybridEP and does not change `moe_use_grouped_tensor`. All perf settings (GTP, CUDA graphs, offload, recompute) are inherited unchanged.
- Declare the recipe's `cfg.env_vars` inline (`**COMMON_PERF_ENV_VARS`, `**DETERMINISM_ENV_VARS`, plus the base recipe's settings), as required for flat perf recipes and matching the DeepSeek V3 deterministic recipe. The resulting environment equals the base environment plus `DETERMINISM_ENV_VARS`.
- Export it from `megatron.bridge.perf_recipes.nemotronh`.
- Add a unit test: the dispatcher stays NCCL EP, every base env var is preserved, and all determinism env vars are set.

# Validation

256× GB200 (64 nodes), 50 steps, NeMo 26.10 rc7 image, MCore at the Bridge pin. Two deterministic runs (A1, A2) and one non-deterministic baseline (B, the existing fp8mx recipe). Forced load balancing is on, as in all perf recipes.

**Determinism.** A1 and A2 are identical at all 50 steps for lm loss, MTP-1/2 loss and grad norm, at log precision.

**Overhead, steps 20–48 mean.** B hit its 1 h time limit after step 48 because of a slow first-step kernel compile.

| Run | Det | ms/step | MODEL TFLOP/s/GPU |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | on | 4,885 | 603.3 |
| A2 | on | 6,532* | 505.0* |
| B | off | 4,566 | 646.4 |

| Comparison | Step time | TFLOP/s/GPU |
|---|---|---|
| A1 vs B | **+7.0%** | **−6.7%** |
| A2 vs B | +43.1%* | −21.9%* |

A1 vs B is the representative overhead: about **+7% step time** and **−7% TFLOPs**.

\*A2 is an outlier. It ran a burst of slow steps (step 36: 8.1 s, 37: 12.6 s, 38: 17.2 s, 39: 15.5 s, 40: 7.3 s, 41: 6.3 s, 47: 7.0 s). A1 never exceeded 5.6 s and B never exceeded 5.9 s in the same window, and A1/A2 have identical configs and bitwise-identical numerics, so this is most likely a node or fabric issue on A2's allocation, not determinism cost. By median, the gap is about +10% (A1) and +20% (A2).

**W&B runs** (project `nvidia/determinism-zhiyul`):

| Run | Det | W&B |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | on | https://wandb.ai/nvidia/determinism-zhiyul/runs/ofb9265d |
| A2 | on | https://wandb.ai/nvidia/determinism-zhiyul/runs/wzi2vuua |
| B | off | https://wandb.ai/nvidia/determinism-zhiyul/runs/wafqmpvx (timed out after step 48) |

Unit tests: `tests/unit_tests/recipes/nemotronh/test_nemotron_3_ultra.py` and `tests/unit_tests/recipes/test_gb300_ncclep_perf_recipes.py`, 68 passed in the rc7 container.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [x] Make sure you read and followed [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Did you write any new necessary tests?
- [ ] Did you add or update any necessary documentation?
- [ ] Does the PR affect components that are optional to install? (Ex: Numba, Pynini, Apex etc)
  - [ ] Reviewer: Does the PR have correct import guards for all optional libraries?

# Additional Information

- Both deterministic runs hung in process-group teardown after training completed; all results were logged before the hang. Not yet checked on the base recipe (B timed out before teardown), so it is unknown whether this is determinism-specific. Suspect: local CUDA graphs (`cuda_graph_impl="local"`) are not freed by `_delete_cuda_graphs` before `destroy_process_group`.

@@ -32,6 +32,8 @@
     nemotron_3_super_pretrain_config,
     nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_config,
 )
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.utils.determinism_utils import apply_determinism_overrides
+from megatron.bridge.recipes.utils.environment_utils import DETERMINISM_ENV_VARS
 from megatron.bridge.utils.cuda_graph import set_cuda_graph_modules
 
 
@@ -291,6 +293,52 @@ def nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config(*, num_gpus: int = 256)
     return cfg
 
 
+def nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_fp8mx_deterministic_config(*, num_gpus: int = 256) -> ConfigContainer:
+    """Nemotron 3 Ultra pretrain: 256× GB200, MXFP8, deterministic.
+
+    Wraps :func:`nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config` and applies
+    :func:`~megatron.bridge.recipes.utils.determinism_utils.apply_determinism_overrides`.
+    The NCCL EP dispatcher and every other perf setting are kept, so the delta vs the base
+    recipe is the determinism overhead only.
+
+    Args:
+        num_gpus: Launch GPU count used to size HSDP optimizer instances.
+            Defaults to the canonical 256-GPU benchmark allocation.
+    """
+    cfg = nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config(num_gpus=num_gpus)
+    apply_determinism_overrides(cfg)
+    # Keep process settings next to the recipe so users can see the exact benchmark environment.
+    cfg.env_vars = {
+        **COMMON_PERF_ENV_VARS,
+        **DETERMINISM_ENV_VARS,
+        # ---- Others ----
+        # CUDA stream scheduling for this model and parallel layout.
+        "CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS": 32,
+        # CUDA graph and allocator behavior for this recipe.
+        "NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER": 0,
+        "PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF": ("expandable_segments:True,graph_capture_record_stream_reuse:True"),
+        "TORCH_NCCL_AVOID_RECORD_STREAMS": 1,
+        # NCCL user-buffer and launch settings.
+        "NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE": 0,
+        # NCCL EP dispatcher mode and one GPU per rank.
+        "NCCL_EP_HT_EM_PULL_PUSH": 1,
+        # Transformer Engine overlap settings for this model.
+        "NVTE_BWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
+        "NVTE_FWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
+        # Use cuDNN normalization kernels for the VR200 performance candidate.
+        "NVTE_NORM_BWD_USE_CUDNN": 1,
+        "NVTE_NORM_FWD_USE_CUDNN": 1,
+        # Required by fine_grained_activation_offloading (TE >= 2.10.0) to avoid
+        # offloading weights;
+        "NVTE_CPU_OFFLOAD_V1": 1,
+        # Enable TE's CuteDSL fused grouped MLP kernel (sm100+). Required by the
+        # op fuser + fused weighted squared-ReLU with moe_act activation recompute
+        # (ScaledSReLU(activation_recompute_in_mlp=True) only runs on this path).
+        "NVTE_CUTEDSL_FUSED_GROUPED_MLP": 1,
+    }
+    return cfg
+
+
 def nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_nvfp4_config(*, num_gpus: int = 256) -> ConfigContainer:
     """Nemotron 3 Ultra (550B-A55B LatentMoE) pretrain: 256× GB200, NVFP4, GTP.

@@ -20,6 +20,8 @@
 import megatron.bridge.recipes as recipes
 from megatron.bridge.perf_recipes.environment import HYBRID_EP_ENV_NAMES
 from megatron.bridge.perf_recipes.nemotronh import (
+    nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config,
+    nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_fp8mx_deterministic_config,
     nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_nvfp4_config,
     nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb300_nvfp4_config,
     nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_vrnvl72_fp8mx_config,
@@ -188,6 +190,23 @@ def test_gb200_ep16_deterministic_pretrain_applies_determinism() -> None:
     assert cfg.env_vars["NVLINK_DOMAIN_SIZE"] == 72
 
 
+@pytest.mark.unit
+def test_gb200_fp8mx_deterministic_perf_recipe_keeps_nccl_ep() -> None:
+    """The deterministic GB200 MXFP8 recipe is the NCCL EP base plus determinism overrides only."""
+    base = nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_fp8mx_config()
+    cfg = nemotron_3_ultra_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_fp8mx_deterministic_config()
+
+    assert cfg.model.deterministic_mode is True
+    assert cfg.model.cross_entropy_loss_fusion is False
+    assert cfg.model.moe_router_aux_loss_fusion is False
+    assert cfg.model.moe_token_dispatcher_type == base.model.moe_token_dispatcher_type == "flex"
+    assert cfg.model.moe_flex_dispatcher_backend == base.model.moe_flex_dispatcher_backend == "ncclep"
+    assert cfg.model.moe_use_grouped_tensor is base.model.moe_use_grouped_tensor
+    assert cfg.env_vars.keys().isdisjoint(HYBRID_EP_ENV_NAMES)
+    # The inline env copy must stay in sync with the base recipe.
+    assert cfg.env_vars == {**base.env_vars, **DETERMINISM_ENV_VARS}
+
+
 @pytest.mark.unit
 def test_vrnvl72_perf_recipe_uses_nvl72_ultra_topology() -> None:
     """VRNVL72 Ultra preserves the GB300 execution layout with explicit NVL72 settings."""
